TC-21/S20.title: axe scan of both lists and both charts (our own addition)
TC-21/S20.detail: Our own addition (no UAT item or ticket asks for WCAG): recorded, findings are suggestions (A1). axe-core WCAG 2 A/AA on 7 screens x desktop, Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit) on 25acd727: every screen has findings; critical button-name on the NH list (2 icon-only buttons: + and scan) and the NH chart's back arrow (also on the NH Encounter and handoff screens); serious color-contrast on both lists and both Pre-Round tabs; serious nested-interactive on the Hospital card (the remove button inside the card button). Same findings as A1.
